# 123 Network Global Ecosystem

> Multi-sector Solana ecosystem including 123 Tokens, AviaBank, RWA Bank, VisaCrypto, and retail tokens. Flagship token: €Millions (€M).

## Token Standards
All newly minted tokens in this ecosystem (e.g., €Millions, €50, €A220) utilize the **Token-2022** standard on Solana. This allows for advanced features like transfer fees, confidential transfers, and compliance hooks.
